name: Proofread and polish professional email drafts
description: Users asked the assistant to correct, proofread, or polish the grammar, style, and clarity of draft emails and messages in various professional contexts. The requests covered a range of languages, including English, French, and German, and often involved refining tone for business correspondence or specific operational updates.
